title: Real cardinality after subtracting one
statement: Let $\\Omega$ be a finite set with at least two elements. Its cardinality, regarded as a real number, equals one plus the real-valued cardinality obtained by subtracting one from its natural-number cardinality.
hypotheses_covered: The cardinality of $\\Omega$ is at least two
